meta.name: engines
meta.description: 265 (plan L; glossary: Engine registry, AI engine, Judgement service): every AI engine a processing can run with, read only through jav/ai/engines.py. An engine: `label` (its name on screen), `judge` (the judgement service that answers its typed questions, a key of `judges`, or null: GPT answers and the code checks), `requires` (the providers of configs/providers.json it cannot run without: unavailable when one of them is), `bands` (the suffix of its band keys in configs/policy.json `band_for`), `unavailable_status` (a flow's end state when its answerer could not be asked). A judge: `provider` (whose calls it books and budgets) and `todo` (the first part of the to-do it raises when it cannot answer). `default`: the engine of a setting that names none. `legacy`: how a setting saved before the registry names its engine (the recipes' `jev: on | off`).

changelog.note: 265 (plan L, L1; the owner's decision of 2026-11-01: the engine as data, not a JEV on/off switch): first version. jev (JEV and GPT) and gpt (GPT only) as they are, and decisions (OpenAI Decisions and GPT), whose provider is off until its measurement and the owner's decision.
